notes: Labels are single-annotator and have not had independent human review: treat every score as provisional.
This measures agreement between the diagnosis and those labels. It does not measure learning.
Generated sentences and their labels were written by an AI assistant; team sentences were written by the team. Compare the two breakdowns.
Offline-rule scores on the dev split are optimistic: the rules may have been written while looking at it. Quote holdout.

definitions.failed: No diagnosis returned (in AI mode: timeout, HTTP error or malformed output). Never replaced by the offline rules; counted as wrong in every success rate.
definitions.identified_ideas: The idea ids in the diagnosis, plus the scientific idea when the status is "correct".
definitions.end_to_end: Status is in status_any AND, when ideas_any is not empty, at least one identified idea is in ideas_any. Denominator: all cases.
definitions.insufficient_consistent: When status_any holds "insufficient" together with "partial" or "misconception", answering "insufficient" with no identified idea is consistent: not an idea miss.
definitions.ideas_partial: Cases with a non-empty ideas_any: at least one identified idea is acceptable (extra ideas allowed).
definitions.ideas_exact: Cases with a non-empty ideas_any: at least one idea identified and every identified idea is acceptable.
definitions.ideas_none_when_none_expected: Cases with an empty ideas_any: no idea identified.
definitions.per_class: Gold class = first entry of status_any; a prediction found in status_any counts as the gold class. Classes with support > 0 only.
definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean F1 over the classes with support > 0.
definitions.false_correct: Answered cases where "correct" is not acceptable, but the diagnosis is "correct".
definitions.false_misconception: Answered cases whose gold status is "correct" (no wrong-idea status acceptable) that were given a wrong idea.
definitions.clarification: Cases with gold status "insufficient" answered "insufficient" (recall); precision counts "insufficient" answers where it was acceptable.
definitions.experiment_fit: For "misconception"/"multiple" diagnoses whose label names a wrong idea: coverage = the planner recommended an experiment; fits = that experiment contradicts a labelled idea. Planner limits: 45 minutes, all materials, supervision, the pack's highest grade.
definitions.answer_leakage: Answered cases with a status other than "correct" where the learner used none of the pack's answer words: Noor's line or the caption contains one.
definitions.steps_exact: Cases with labelled steps: all three step flags equal the label.
definitions.latency_ms: Nearest-rank percentiles over every attempt, failed ones included.
